deficits.suggestion: Create a continuous footway along the left side to provide safe pedestrian access.
Create a continuous footway along the right side to provide safe pedestrian access.
Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the marked crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait.
Install dropped kerbs at both sides of the marked crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and pedestrians with mobility aids.
Install street lights along the right side of the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers.

ratings.reason: The frames show a narrow street with buildings close to the road, making it impossible to confirm the absence of a footway or the feasibility of building one.
Similar to the left side, the view is obstructed by parked cars and the angle does not provide a clear view of the entire right-side pavement.
The road appears to be a standard two-lane street, and the frames do not clearly show a wide enough median or a signalised crossing to confirm the need for a refuge island.
The crosswalks are visible, but the specific condition of the kerbs (whether they are dropped or not) cannot be determined from the provided frames.
While some streetlights are visible, the frames do not provide a comprehensive view of the entire street to confirm a complete lack of lighting on the right side.
